name: MyChama
audience: Chamas, savings groups and small SACCO-style groups
description: Members, contributions, loans, Merry-Go-Round, payments, SMS and minutes for your chama, working even without signal.
longDescription: MyChama runs a chama from start to finish: members and officer roles, contributions, loans, Merry-Go-Round pots, M-Pesa payments, SMS to members, meeting minutes and financial reports. Chairs, treasurers and secretaries each see what their role needs, and the app keeps working in meetings with no signal.
problem: Group money often lives in notebooks, spreadsheets and chat threads, so contributions, loans and arrears are hard to track and harder to trust.
features: Chair, treasurer, secretary and member roles
Contributions on daily, weekly or monthly cycles, with arrears
Loan products with flat or reducing-balance rates and repayment schedules
Merry-Go-Round pots with payouts and arrears
Members pay contributions and loan repayments by M-Pesa
Cash payments recorded by finance officers
SMS to members, including scheduled reminders
Financial reports: member statements, cashflow, profit and loss, balance sheet
Works offline and syncs when signal returns
Sign in with phone, Google or email
steps: Create your chama and set the contribution amount and cycle.
Add members by phone number. Each member claims their invite the first time they sign in.
Record contributions, loans and Merry-Go-Round payments, or let members pay by M-Pesa.
Send reminders, keep minutes and download reports for your meetings.

priceNote: SMS credits are bought separately: KES 0.90 each on Free to Basic, KES 0.70 on Growth and KES 0.50 on Max. Online payments carry Paystack's transaction fee plus a small MyChama service fee, shown before you pay.
priceSummary: From free (6 members) to KES 4,990 a month. See the plans above.
connects: Online payments run through Samuhia Payments, and approved Samuhia Desk agents can set up and support your chama.

faq.a: Chamas, small SACCO-style groups and other community savings groups.

faq.q: How many members can I add?
faq.a: The Free plan allows 6 members. Paid plans allow 15, 25, 60 or up to 999 members.
Yes. Records made offline are saved on the device and sync when the signal returns. Sending SMS needs internet.

faq.q: Can members use it without installing an app?
faq.a: Members can install the web app, and a WhatsApp assistant handles common member actions.

faq.q: Is there a WhatsApp number for MyChama?
faq.a: Yes. Message the SAMUHIA WhatsApp bot on +254 101 716 473 and choose My Chama from the menu. It works in English and Kiswahili.

whatsappBot: Members can open My Chama from the SAMUHIA WhatsApp bot on +254 101 716 473, in English or Kiswahili.
